d:
Priy vyuar,
Do. vikas divyakirti ke is vidiyo men 'Empathy' aur 'Sympathy' shabdon ka arth va antar spasht kiya gaya hai. iska sanbandh ethiks khand (samany adhyayan pepar-4) se hai. samany tatha prashasnik jivan ke udaharnon ko aadhar banakar is vidiyo men spasht kiya gaya hai ki manovigyan men prayukt hone vale in donon shabdon (Empathy aur Sympathy) men kya antar hai aur kis bindu par vah antar samapt ho sakta hai?
